rubric.criterion: States the impact: checkout failed for roughly 19 minutes (about 09:07 to 09:26 UTC) and about 1,840 checkouts failed.
Says clearly that nobody was charged twice and that no data was lost.
Explains the cause in plain words, such as a new update that put too much load on the database, without terms like connection pool, query, API or db-primary.
Says the fix was undoing the update (a rollback) and that checkout was back to normal by 09:30 UTC.
Names both follow-up steps: load testing before each release, and an alert when database capacity runs low.
Apologises once, sincerely, without excuses and without blaming any person or team.
Has 5 to 7 sentences and at most 140 words.
